title: Navigate to Purchase Orders
instruction: Open the Procurement menu and select Create Purchase Order (ME21N).
hint_text: Press Tab to reach the Procurement menu item or click directly on the left sidebar.

title: Enter Organization Header
instruction: Fill in Purchasing Organization (1000) and Purchasing Group (001).
hint_text: Use Tab to navigate between Header fields. Pre-filled defaults can be kept.

title: Select Vendor & Terms
instruction: Enter the designated Vendor Code (US-VEND-100) and assign payment terms.
hint_text: Look up vendor code in the directory or type US-VEND-100 directly into the Vendor field.

title: Add Line Items & Submit
instruction: Enter Material Number (M-01), Quantity (10), and click Save & Submit PO.
hint_text: Review total net value in the item summary table before pressing Submit.
